observations: Two corn threshers are shown, one with a green base and red top, the other with a black base and red top.
The green-based thresher has Chinese characters on stickers: '又净又快 结实耐用' (clean and fast, sturdy and durable) and '加厚钢板 螺旋设计' (thickened steel plate, spiral design).
The machines have a hopper at the top, a cylindrical body, and a base with wheels or casters.
The green-based thresher has a perforated metal panel on the front of the base.
The black-based thresher appears similar in design but lacks visible branding or text.
The setting is an outdoor area with pipes and other equipment in the background, suggesting a workshop or sales yard.
The watermark 'WILSOTECH AGRO-ALLIED' is present on all photos.

claims.claim: Very efficient corn thresher with a Lasting Structure which will not worn or wear out or collapse
claims.evidence: No visible signs of wear or damage, but durability and efficiency cannot be confirmed from photos alone. The Chinese text '结实耐用' (sturdy and durable) is present on the green machine (photo 1 and 2), which supports the claim to some extent, but does not prove it.

risks.risk: The machine may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine operating or a close-up of the internal mechanism and motor.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing parts or have damaged components not visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the hopper, internal drum, and drive mechanism.

risks.risk: The machine may not be suitable for local corn varieties or may require a power source not specified.
risks.proof: A photo of the power input (e.g., motor, engine, or electrical connection) and a demonstration of operation.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified for local use

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation.
Close-up of the internal mechanism and motor.
Photo of the power source or engine.
Proof of the machine's origin or manufacturer (if available).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a corn thresher, but its functionality, completeness, and suitability for local use cannot be confirmed from the current photos. The seller's claims about durability and efficiency are unverifiable remotely. Proof of operation and internal condition is needed before pricing.
